evals.name: single-module-library-patch-release
evals.prompt: Release v1.2.1 of my Go library github.com/myorg/myrepo. The last tag was v1.2.0 and I just merged a bug fix into master. Walk me through the exact commands.
evals.expected_output: A step-by-step release checklist for a single-module Go library patch release, including version bump, CHANGELOG update, go.mod cleanup, annotated tag creation, push, proxy verification, and GitHub Release creation.
expectations: Response recommends a patch version bump to v1.2.1
Response mentions cleaning or auditing replace directives in go.mod
Response includes running go mod tidy before tagging
Response instructs to create an annotated tag with git tag -a v1.2.1
Response warns that published tags are immutable and cannot be moved once proxy.golang.org caches them
Response includes verifying the release with go get github.com/myorg/myrepo@v1.2.1 in a clean directory
Response includes creating a GitHub Release from the tag (gh release create or GitHub UI)

evals.name: multi-module-monorepo-minor-release
evals.prompt: Cut a release of my multi-module Go monorepo at github.com/myorg/mono. There are two modules: github.com/myorg/mono and github.com/myorg/mono/cli. I need to release v1.3.0 of both from the same commit. What exact git tags do I push and in what order?
evals.expected_output: A multi-module release procedure that tags both modules at the same commit, updates cross-module requires with go mod edit, and explicitly sets GORELEASER_CURRENT_TAG if using GoReleaser.
expectations: Response identifies this as a multi-module monorepo release and references references/multi-module.md
Response states that both tags (mono/v1.3.0 and cli/v1.3.0) must point to the same commit
Response mentions using go mod edit -require to bump the cli module's dependency on the root module without needing the proxy yet
Response warns about the chicken-and-egg problem of go mod tidy before tags are pushed
Response mentions setting GORELEASER_CURRENT_TAG=mono/v1.3.0 if GoReleaser is used
Response includes post-push verification with GONOSUMDB=* go get for both modules

evals.name: goreleaser-binary-release-wrong-tag
evals.prompt: Build a v2.0.0 release of my Go CLI github.com/myorg/tool using GoReleaser. The last tag push included three tags on the same commit and GoReleaser keeps picking the wrong one. How do I fix the release and what does the .goreleaser.yml look like?
evals.expected_output: A GoReleaser binary release procedure that sets GORELEASER_CURRENT_TAG explicitly, uses a minimal v2 config with version: 2, and explains why git describe picks the alphabetically-last tag.
expectations: Response sets GORELEASER_CURRENT_TAG=v2.0.0 for the release command or CI job
Response explains that multiple tags at one commit cause git describe to pick the alphabetically-last tag
Response includes a .goreleaser.yml with version: 2 at the top
Response includes CGO_ENABLED=0 and -trimpath for cross-compilation
Response mentions running goreleaser release --clean --snapshot --skip=publish to test the pipeline first
Response warns that v2.0.0 for a CLI is semver, not necessarily a Go module v2 path migration
